knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The standard recommends an external audit no less often than every two years.
The external auditor must be qualified and independent of both the facility and the cleaning provider.
The cycle becomes yearly until internal auditing and corrective action are shown to be effective.

practicalCriteria: Learner states from a sample record whether the external cycle is two-yearly or yearly, with the correct cycle given and the reason named
Learner names an independent and a non-independent auditor from a sample list, with both classified correctly
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample audit record classified by the learner
stopWorkCriteria: An internal audit reveals an unmanaged infection risk, which must go to the infection prevention coordinator at once
